title: Open Firestore Write Permissions on Financial & Approval Collections
businessImpact: Any authenticated user (couriers, cashiers) can directly modify orders, payments, cash sessions, inventory, and approve discount requests via direct Firestore SDK calls.
recommendedFix: Implement granular Role-Based Access Control in firestore.rules restricting writes on approvals, cashSessions, and inventory to isPrivileged() only.

title: Insecure Fallback Manager PIN (1234) & No Brute-Force Rate Limiting
businessImpact: When offline or unconfigured, entering '1234' unlocks manager operations. Absence of rate-limiting allows automated brute-forcing in milliseconds.
recommendedFix: Remove '1234' fallback to fail closed on missing hash, and introduce a progressive lockout timer for repeated incorrect entries.

title: Drawer Settlement Drops Bypass Accounting Ledger, Writing Only Local Audit Log
businessImpact: Cash drops to the safe do not decrease expected cash in active session, causing massive false cash shortages on shift close Z-Reports.
recommendedFix: Persist cash drops to CashSessionRepository, update CashSession.droppedCash, and deduct from expectedCash calculation.

title: Violation of Blind Cash Count: Expected Cash & Variance Displayed During Count
businessImpact: Cashiers can see calculated drawer totals and live variance while entering banknote counts, allowing dishonest operators to manipulate counts to hide theft.
recommendedFix: Implement strict two-phase UX hiding expected cash and variance until physical count is permanently committed.

title: Audit Log Entries Strictly Local to Device, Unsynchronized to Cloud Firestore
businessImpact: Local terminal crash or browser cache wipe permanently erases the audit trail of voids, discounts, and overrides across all branches.
recommendedFix: Include audit_entries in RecordMirror and add append-only security rule in firestore.rules.

title: ESC/POS Thermal Network Printer Sends Raw UTF-8 Without Arabic BiDi Shaping
businessImpact: Standard ESC/POS thermal printers print disconnected, reversed, or illegible characters when sent raw UTF-8 Arabic bytes.
recommendedFix: Render tickets as off-screen raster bitmaps (GS v 0) or implement Arabic ligature shaping with CP864/CP1256 encoding.

title: Missing Android Background Location Tracking Service (Foreground Service)
businessImpact: When courier locks screen or takes a call, Android suspends location updates, halting real-time fleet dispatch tracking.
recommendedFix: Add FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and configure foreground notification.

title: Web/PWA Platform Incompatible with Raw ESC/POS TCP Socket Printing (Port 9100)
businessImpact: Web cashiers cannot print to thermal receipt printers over TCP port 9100 due to browser sandbox restrictions.
recommendedFix: Document Web platform for browser HTML printing and clarify that network port 9100 printing requires Desktop or Android.

title: Mock Supervisor Temporary Delegation Code (DEL-7921) Unbacked by Service
businessImpact: Supervisor delegation feature is non-functional; displays static mock code with zero backend generation or verification.
recommendedFix: Implement dynamic 6-digit OTP generation with 60-minute TTL backed by Firestore delegation_codes.

title: Order Checkout Does Not Trigger Recipe / BOM Inventory Depletion
businessImpact: Ingredient stock balances on hand never deplete upon selling food items, breaking food cost accounting.
recommendedFix: Attach recipe BOM lists to MenuItemModel and invoke recordMovement on order finalization.

title: Mock Cross-Branch Emergency Rerouting and Rebalancing Actions
businessImpact: Emergency order rerouting button only displays a SnackBar notification and performs no actual order rebalancing.
recommendedFix: Wire TriageService to reassign pending order branchId and notify target branch.

title: Inbound Remote Sync Lacks Timestamp / Vector Clock Ordering Protection
businessImpact: Delayed Firestore snapshots arriving out-of-order can overwrite newer local Sembast state.
recommendedFix: Check record timestamp against local record prior to updating Sembast store.

title: Update Artifact Verification Buffers Entire Multi-Megabyte APK in Memory
businessImpact: Loading entire 60MB-100MB APK files into Dart byte array can cause Out-Of-Memory crashes on low-end Android POS terminals.
recommendedFix: Use chunked streaming digest calculation via File.openRead().transform(sha256).

title: Unauthenticated GitHub Release API Calls Vulnerable to IP Rate Limiting (HTTP 403)
businessImpact: Multiple terminals behind shared restaurant NAT Wi-Fi exceed 60 requests/hour limit, resulting in update check failures.
recommendedFix: Send If-None-Match ETag headers on update check requests to receive HTTP 304 without consuming rate limits.

title: Outdated Emoji and Icon Assertions in Driver Delivery Flow Tests
businessImpact: Two test failures out of 576 in test suite cause false CI/CD deployment blocks.
recommendedFix: Update button finder to 'عرض البون 🧾' and remove stale fake journey play button assertion.
